purpose: Define the ordered validation commands required to prove God Mode development across product, platform, AI, security, governance, rollback, and CI readiness.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves God Mode skill, plugin capability, governance doc, and operating contract exist.
commandGroups.failureMode: God Mode cannot be treated as an operating mode if the skill, policy, or contract is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, and Agents are mapped to five required layers.
commandGroups.failureMode: The ecosystem is not improved across modules if a required module or layer is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves active goals include acceptance criteria, validation commands, rollback, and evidence links.
commandGroups.failureMode: A goal cannot be complete if its evidence or rollback path is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves repository lanes track app, package, plugin, docs, agents, CI, security, and rollback posture.
commandGroups.failureMode: A repo slice cannot be release-ready if health lanes or publish safety are missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves architecture, quality, AI policy, module coverage, goals, repos, agents, release readiness, and validation docs are indexed.
commandGroups.failureMode: Governance is not durable if documentation is not indexed and source-controlled.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves agent lanes declare skill source, autonomy, tool boundaries, safety boundaries, and validation duties.
commandGroups.failureMode: Agentic behavior is not safe if autonomy and validation duties are not explicit.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves security, AI policy, quality evidence, rollback, and CI readiness gates exist.
commandGroups.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if security, AI, rollback, or CI evidence is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves the validation sequence, proof targets, dashboard visibility, and governance link are source-controlled.
commandGroups.failureMode: Validation cannot be trusted if the proof sequence itself is not checked.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves the current God Mode slice is bounded by module, gate, primary files, rollback, and pending validation state.
commandGroups.failureMode: Commit readiness cannot be assessed if the work package is not explicit and reversible.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves architecture decisions have a template, example ADR, workflow doc, dashboard visibility, and quality gate.
commandGroups.failureMode: Durable architecture changes cannot be trusted if decision capture is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves summary, changed surfaces, validation status, risks, rollback, next commands, and protected user work are explicit.
commandGroups.failureMode: Repo handoff is unsafe if validation status, risks, rollback, or protected user work are not explicit.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves completion remains blocked until every required item has current validation, commit, push, CI, and protected-user-work evidence.
commandGroups.failureMode: Completion claims are unsafe if missing evidence is not tracked explicitly.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves the current God Mode package remains pending until source, runtime, telemetry, validation, commit, push, CI, and protected-user-work states are explicit.
commandGroups.failureMode: Execution state is unsafe if pending validation and missing CI evidence are not visible.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves the intended staging boundary, protected paths, excluded categories, and quality-chain grouping are source-controlled.
commandGroups.failureMode: Commit preparation is unsafe if staging boundaries and protected paths are not explicit.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves all added God Mode feature groups are captured as draft-unverified release notes with evidence and validation gates.
commandGroups.failureMode: Release notes are unsafe if added features are incomplete, untracked, or claimed release-ready before validation.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, Agents, Security, AI Policy, Rollback, Validation, and Handoff each have feature or governance improvement evidence plus remaining gaps.
commandGroups.failureMode: The broad God Mode objective is unsafe if topic-by-topic feature growth evidence is missing.

commandGroups.proofTarget: Proves the repo-level governance chain includes all required God Mode gates.
commandGroups.failureMode: Completion cannot be claimed if the full governance chain has not passed.

completionRule: Completion requires successful execution evidence for the relevant feature gates and full quality governance before commit, push, release, or completion claims.
